استذميا (form X)
# اِسْتَذْمَيَا (istaḏmayā) /is.tað.ma.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
# اُسْتُذْمِيَا (ustuḏmiyā) /us.tuð.mi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
# اِسْتَذْمِيَا (istaḏmiyā) /is.tað.mi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
